title: Build template-driven and generic visual OCR

environment.profile: local offline acceptance; synthetic fixtures only

evidence: English default and French registration-seam tests

scope_boundary: English uppercase identity-document visual zones are the production baseline. French is architected and tested as a replaceable language-pack seam but its glyph pack is not shipped by AC03.

security_performance_reviews.security: PASS: unreadable characters are never generatively filled, confidence/review state is engine-controlled, and input pixels are cloned
security_performance_reviews.performance: Not separately required for the dependency-free offline engine

known_unrelated_quality_failure: Full quality reports missing frontend dependencies and the pre-existing BIO-FND-009 observability race; all BIO-DOC-004 gates pass

final_acceptance.reason: All five acceptance criteria have executable builder and independent evidence; fresh feature, structural and repository gates pass.
